title: Audit repo state before next feature work
objective: Perform a read-only pre-feature cleanup audit of the repository state. Check current working tree status, recent Tower workflow state, relevant flashlight/Rerun code and docs consistency, and identify any cleanup needed before building more features.
instructions: Do not modify files and do not perform git cleanup operations.
Inspect the working tree status and summarize tracked/untracked changes, branch/ahead-behind state if available, and whether the repo is ready for further feature work.

Review recent Tower ResultPackets and current docs/code around examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py, examples/flashlight/README.md, and docs/running_our_example_applications.md for drift or inconsistencies.
Call out whether cleanup should be delegated to Git-master, Builder, or Scribe, and provide exact recommended next packet objective if follow-up is needed.
expected_outputs: Inspector ResultPacket with findings ordered by severity and concrete cleanup recommendations.
definition_of_done: Repo state and flashlight/Rerun code-doc consistency have been checked read-only.
Next cleanup handoff, if needed, is clearly identified.
